## What changed

- The cutover window moved to **Sunday 22/11, 02:00–04:00 UTC**, because Fernhill's month-end batch runs Saturday night until ~06:00 UTC. Maya has told the CSMs and says you can update the runbook and merge #321 [8]. Your runbook and the Notion page still say Saturday 21/11 [1][10].
- Maya approved #321 but asked you not to merge before the window is confirmed with Fernhill [3]. Her later Slack message says it's confirmed [8].
- Daniel Levi will be on call for the API side on Sunday. He wants a ping when you start the switchover [7].
- Lior Ben-David (KES-530) needs nothing changed for the ingest workers, since they read DATABASE_URL from SSM. He wants 30 minutes' notice before the switchover so he can pause the consumers [9].

## What is still open

- **Runbook and #321 merge:** update the window to Sunday 22/11 in `runbooks/pg17-cutover.md`, then merge #321 [1][8]. Add the 30-minute notice to Lior and the ping to Daniel to the steps [7][9].
- **Rollback rehearsal:** this is still to do on a fresh clone, planned for Thursday 19/11. Switching back to blue is not a real rollback, because the old instance gets no writes after switchover and diverges immediately. The runbook carries this as a TODO [1][3].

## What you did

- Prod PG17 blue/green is ready in PR #321: the Terraform change, a fix so the read replica follows the blue/green instead of being replaced, and the runbook [1][3].
- A rehearsal on a clone of last night's snapshot gave 74 s of write downtime and no row-count mismatches on the 20 biggest tables. You deleted the clone afterwards [1].
